currentParagraphText: “Oh, how is he doing?” Jake asked curiously. “Last I heard, the Devil King there made him his Chosen, so I reckon he’s doing well?”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “He’s doing quite well indeed,” Irin nodded. “In fact, he’s very recently gotten engaged to the daughter of the Devil Queen of the Second Hell in quite a momentous union.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Irin looked in thought for a while before answering. “Well, I’m not sure if it’s massive in your eyes, but I went to the Fourth Hell and met with the Demon Prince.”
